Risk Statement: Unpatched vulnerabilities on the Proxmox host could be exploited by an attacker, resulting in unauthorised access to virtual machines and disruption of multiple services.
Existing Controls: Administrative access restricted to LAN; firewall rules; strong administrator credentials
Additional Controls: Formal patch-management schedule; restrict management access; maintain configuration backups

Risk Statement: Misconfigured firewall rules could permit unauthorised network traffic, allowing an attacker to access systems that should be isolated.
Existing Controls: OPNsense firewall; network segmentation; default-deny approach where appropriate
Additional Controls: Periodic firewall-rule review; documented rule purpose; remove unused rules

Risk Statement: Malware infection on the Windows 11 workstation could compromise credentials or data and provide a foothold for further attacks.
Existing Controls: Windows security features; firewall; restricted network environment
Additional Controls: Keep OS and applications patched; endpoint protection; least privilege; user awareness

Risk Statement: Unauthorised access to the Ubuntu file server could expose, alter or delete stored information.
Existing Controls: Linux permissions; firewall; restricted network access
Additional Controls: Least-privilege permissions; separate user accounts; SSH hardening; regular backup and restore testing

Risk Statement: Loss or unauthorised modification of firewall and network configuration backups could prevent timely recovery following a system failure.
Additional Controls: Automated or scheduled encrypted backups; offline copy; periodic restoration test

Risk Statement: A compromised or misconfigured security-testing VM could be used to attack other systems or bypass intended network boundaries.
Vulnerability: High-risk security tools and broad network access
Additional Controls: Restrict network routes; shut down when not required; snapshot before testing; document authorised test scope

Risk Statement: Compromise of an administrator account could allow an attacker to alter firewall or network settings and compromise connected systems.
Existing Controls: Management interface not exposed directly to the internet
Additional Controls: MFA where supported; unique administrator accounts; disable unused accounts; strong password policy

Risk Statement: Failure to maintain reliable backups could result in permanent loss of systems or data following hardware failure, ransomware or configuration error.
Additional Controls: 3-2-1 backup approach; offline or separate backup copy; scheduled restore testing

Risk Statement: Insufficient isolation of the playground VLAN could allow a compromised test system to access trusted network resources.
Additional Controls: Explicit deny rules between playground and trusted networks; periodic segmentation testing

Risk Statement: Outdated network and system documentation could lead to incorrect security decisions and increase recovery time during an incident.
Additional Controls: Version-controlled documentation; review after significant changes; documented asset ownership
